docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A complete guide to the C language: types, operators and control flow, functions, arrays and strings, pointers and dynamic memory, structures and unions, the preprocessor, input and output, the standard library and common idioms and pitfalls.

From Wikibooks · CC BY-SA 4.0

C Programming, a Wikibooks textbook, by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikibooks when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0. Modified: converted to this format.
